claim.text: Microsoft documents that WORKDAY.INTL accepts weekend selectors 1-7 and 11-17 or a seven-character Monday-first 0/1 mask, truncates noninteger day offsets, and returns #NUM! for out-of-range date results. Microsoft documents that NETWORKDAYS.INTL counts endpoints inclusively, returns negative counts for reversed ranges, and returns zero for the all-one weekend mask. Formula Atlas implements these documented rules in Python and Rust and keeps numeric-selector coercion, fractional dates, holiday-cell handling, and the exact WORKDAY.INTL all-one-mask error as unverified profiles.
claim.subject_definition: WORKDAY.INTL and NETWORKDAYS.INTL in Excel for Microsoft 365 desktop

source.excerpt: Microsoft Support function pages list the numeric weekend codes and mask encoding, document offset/count behavior and date-bound errors, and provide examples. They do not specify all coercion details or the exact error for WORKDAY.INTL's invalid all-one mask.
